reasoning: Four rounded corner brackets form a rectangular viewfinder or fullscreen frame. While frequently used as interface chrome for fullscreen toggles, it serves as a recognizable icon for tasks centered on taking screenshots, capturing screen regions, or scanning documents, though it can be confused with QR code scanners or generic crop tools.

pass1.ambiguity: Easily read as generic UI chrome for entering fullscreen mode rather than a concrete object; also overlaps with barcode/QR scanner icons that lack a center scan line, and with image crop icons.
